No release yet. Graphvein is pre-release. Release binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux, with their checksums and build provenance, come with the first release. Until then, build from source.

Build from source

No release yet. Build from source.

The source is published later.

bash build.sh   # writes bin/tool

Then:

graphvein index
graphvein serve   # web UI

Only Go is needed.
